name: VOD Concurrency Fix
description: Dispatcharr plugin that coalesces the near-simultaneous range requests from some clients (notably Emby) when playing MKV VOD files so they share one provider slot instead of failing over to a different file and corrupting playback.
author: andyj682

actions.label: Show patch status
actions.description: Report whether the concurrency patch is active in the worker that handles this request.
